title: Upload and link evidence
summary: A draft guide for adding evidence and connecting it to the relevant compliance work.

items: Use an approved document or record that supports the relevant compliance work.
Check that the evidence does not contain information that your organisation should not upload.
Confirm the control, requirement, or assessment item to which the evidence should be linked.
Open the approved DRisk area for managing evidence.
Choose the workflow for adding a document or evidence record.
Provide the information requested by your configured workflow and add the approved file if appropriate.
Link the evidence to the relevant control, requirement, or assessment item.
Review the saved record and confirm that the link is understandable to another reviewer.
